title: 30% Discount (Capped at USD$15) on Prepaid Credit Top-Ups @ Roamless
body:
Deal: 30% Discount (Capped at USD$15) on Prepaid Credit Top-Ups @ Roamless

[armageddeus] Last Christmas there was a 50% coupon. Didn't see one for BF.
[BozoDubbedOver] I believe it is $15 USD not AUD so keep that in mind
[sputzy] You're correct thanks, forgot to mention but have updated the post now.
[jv] There is also a service fee unless you top up more than $20USD
[armageddeus] Works well if u have a sim+esim (dual) mobile. Use amaysim/aldi $15 payg (incoming calls) + roamless (data/ payg calls). Cheapskate mobile service lifehack that works even while roaming.
[mameimo] Is Roamless cheaper than Aldi $15 payg for payg calls?
[armageddeus] Yes. Roamless $0.06usd vs Aldi $0.15aud /min
[igorekh] Yeah, it still amazes me that Amaysim charges A$51.20/GB on its PAYG plan, while Roamless is only A$3.50/GB (even cheaper with all the discounts) 🤯
